q: We see that the single cdki that is required for primary neurogenesis in Xenopus, p27Xic1 [ 28 ] is not transcriptionally up-regulated by WT NeuroD4.

2015 June 18, Laura J. A. Hardwick, Anna Philpott, “Multi-site phosphorylation regulates NeuroD4 activity during primary neurogenesis: a conserved mechanism amongst proneural proteins”, in Neural Deve
